definitions.gloss: increasing sophistication; becoming more elaborate or refined
definitions.explanation: The process of something becoming more intricate, precise, or sophisticated over time. Often used in contexts of technology, craftsmanship, fraud techniques, or design.

examples.japanese: サイバー{攻撃|こうげき}の{手口|てぐち}が{精巧化|せいこうか}している。
examples.english: Cyber attack methods are becoming increasingly sophisticated.

examples.japanese: {偽造|ぎぞう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{精巧化|せいこうか}により、{偽札|にせさつ}の{発見|はっけん}が{難|むずか}しくなった。
examples.english: Due to the increasing sophistication of counterfeiting technology, it has become harder to detect fake bills.

examples.japanese: {製品|せいひん}の{精巧化|せいこうか}が{進|すす}む{一方|いっぽう}で、{修理|しゅうり}にかかるコストも{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: While products are becoming more sophisticated, repair costs are also rising.

notes:
Composed of {精巧|せいこう} (elaborate/exquisite) and {化|か} (transformation/-ization). The suffix {化|か} indicates a process of change or becoming. Often appears in news and technical writing about evolving threats, technologies, or techniques.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精巧化|せいこうか}が{進|すす}む: sophistication advances
- {精巧化|せいこうか}する: to become more sophisticated
- {手口|てぐち}の{精巧化|せいこうか}: increasing sophistication of methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高度化|こうどか}: advancement/becoming more advanced — broader scope
- {巧妙化|こうみょうか}: becoming more cunning — carries a negative nuance (trickery)
- {複雑化|ふくざつか}: becoming more complex — focuses on complexity rather than refinement
- {精巧|せいこう}: elaborate/exquisite — the base adjective
